title: Heidi Klum Returning To 'America's Got Talent' Amid Simon Cowell Absence
text:
As Simon Cowell continues to recover from back surgery, another America's Got Talent alum is returning to the judges table.
Elliot Page Hasn’t Had Any Roles Since ‘The Odyssey’, But Feels He “Could Do Some Of My Best Work Now” ‘Jawbreaker’ Stage Musical Shines Spotlight On Vylette’s “Trans Narrative” With Non-Binary Actor AJ Paramo Simon Cowell and Heidi Klum pose on the 'America's Got Talent' red carpet on Sept. 20, 2023 in Pasadena, California.
Watch on Deadline Cowell was not on the show this week as he is taking time off to undergo the procedure, described as routine and linked to the serious e-bike accident he suffered in August 2020, which led to complex spinal injury and long rehab.
